preconditions.description: The number of engineers N is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
The input contains exactly N+1 lines: the first line is N, followed by N lines of desk pairs.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= current <= 2*N and 1 <= desired <= 2*N for current, desired in pairs)
preconditions.description: All desk numbers (current and desired) are integers between 1 and 2*N inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(set(current for current, _ in pairs)) == N
preconditions.description: No two engineers currently sit at the same desk; all current desk numbers are distinct.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer modulo 10^9 + 7.

The output equals the number of valid seating arrangements modulo 10^9 + 7, where a valid assignment maps each engineer to either their current desk or their desired desk such that all assigned desks are distinct.
